scope: Local Application and synthetic Worker/MCP; no live calls or deployment

checks.name: App release build and three pinned Worker dry builds
Package skill, changed prose, whitespace and document validation

acceptance_evidence: Thirteen neutral cases agree across typed Application queries, direct TypeScript and actual Workspace/MCP calls. Pure queries preserve the source document.
Category/project/label/goal lists exclude archived records, preserve canonical IDs and document order, and enforce guarded pages and exact applicable selectors.
Sections require an active parent and stable position ordering, including tied positions.

Goal counts include only explicitly linked nonarchived/noncancelled Todos. Mixed recurring/Habit/archive/cancelled cases yield one completed of two eligible; an empty goal yields zero eligible, with no completion fraction claim.
All five tools advertise read-only annotations under tasks:read. Missing grants fail at MCP/private Workspace and another profile sees no records.
Reads create no command/preparation rows and issue zero upstream writes. Guidance distinguishes supported organization reads from unavailable writes.
limitations: Organization writes, task assignment/planning commands, completed-history/restore and advanced skill workflows remain Pending.
Production UI, actual client/packaged-skill activation and live qualification remain unrun.
